dvids.title: NNSY Teams Prepare Pier 5 for Historic First Visit from USS Gerald R. Ford
dvids.desc: For the first time in its storied history, Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY) had to prepare to welcome the USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) for its first Planned Incremental Availability.
